assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: very wide website banner background artwork, 3:1 landscape composition, no typography. Create an original photorealistic premium football arena at night in deep royal blue and midnight navy, cinematic stadium floodlights across the top with a dazzling icy white light just right of centre, curving stadium grandstands and subtle atmospheric haze. One large polished silver-white and navy pentagon football standing on the pitch around 62 percent of image width, occupying 65 percent of image height, entire ball visible, low camera angle. Leave the left 45 percent dark navy and uncluttered for live HTML heading; leave rightmost 20 percent dark blue for a short overlay motto. Crisp realistic football panel seams, specular highlights, blue glow, rich photographic depth, premium sports broadcast visual, visually impressive without excessive lightning. No lettering, no words, no numbers, no logos, no interface, no people, no watermark. The artwork will be cropped responsively to a shallow banner; important ball centred vertically and 62 percent horizontally.
